notice.durability_intro: Several factors influence the final outcome:
notice.factor1: Your lifestyle, activity level, and overall health
notice.factor2: Your individual nail features (structure, oiliness, growth rate)
notice.factor3: The level of mechanical damage you expose your nails to
notice.guarantee: We do not guarantee specific results for our work, including any predictions regarding how long a treatment will last.
notice.hormonal_intro: Hormonal changes during pregnancy, breastfeeding, or the menstrual cycle may affect how long your service lasts.
notice.however: However, we will do everything possible to ensure your comfort.

privacy.changes_text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.
privacy.cookies_analytics: Analytics cookies (optional): help us understand how visitors use the site so we can improve it.
privacy.cookies_necessary: Necessary cookies (always active): enable core functionality such as page navigation and access to secure areas.
privacy.cookies_text: We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your browsing experience. Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website.
privacy.improve: To improve our services and tailor your experience
privacy.info_text: We may collect the following types of information:
privacy.name: Name
privacy.respond: To respond to your inquiries and bookings
privacy.rights_text: Under applicable data protection laws, you have the following rights: access and obtain a copy of your data on request; correct any inaccurate or incomplete data; request deletion of your data when it is no longer necessary for the purposes for which it was collected; restrict processing in certain circumstances; object to processing for direct marketing purposes.
privacy.security_text: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
privacy.send: How we use your information — we use the information we collect to: process and confirm your appointment bookings; communicate with you about your appointment and related services
privacy.service: Service details (type of treatment, appointment date/time)
privacy.sharing_text: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data to third parties. We may share your information with: service providers who help us operate our booking system (such as our online scheduling platform); legal authorities when required by applicable law.
privacy.use: Cookies & usage information (how you interact with our website, collected via standard web analytics tools)
privacy.use_text: Contact information (name, phone number, email address, social media handle)
